# Stephen Beddoe

Stephen Beddoe has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-beddoe#e7)

  Not elected.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/stephen-beddoe#e12)

  Not elected.

* * *

* * *

## Election History

### 2005 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Helier No 2](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier-no-2) (3 seats), 23rd November 2005.

**Stephen Beddoe was not elected**.
